subject: Press Release
detail: In accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with the applicable SEBI circulars, we wish to inform you that Aether Industries Limited has today entered into a Facility Development and Supply Agreement with Baker Petrolite LLC, a Baker Hughes Company, as attached.

subject: General Updates
